name: Seibogari
source:
Masheri lives in the nocturnal city of "Asashirazu." She works at a tavern, reads books by her favorite authors, and leads her otherwise quiet life there. This place is her home. Yet, deep down, she dreams of the day she might leave Asashirazu behind.

One day, a traveler named Giorgio moves into the house next door. As the two meet and grow closer, their interactions forge a connection that changes the dynamic between them. And yet, beneath it all hides a darker tale...

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/girls/work/=/product_id/RJ345521.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
马谢里生活在夜间都市“朝志”。她在一家小酒馆工作，阅读她最喜欢的作家的书籍，并在那里过着平静的生活。这个地方就是她的家。然而，在内心深处，她梦想着有一天能把朝天抛在身后。

有一天，一位名叫乔治的旅行者搬进了隔壁的房子。随着两人相遇并变得更加亲密，他们的互动形成了一种联系，改变了他们之间的动态。然而，这一切的背后却隐藏着一个更黑暗的故事……
